answer: At first cut the bowlpolisher works at the latheroom, hollows the bowl at dawn and rounds the spindle while the shavings settle. The lathehouse means nothing without Cherry mandrel woodshaper benchshop bond: a bond mandrel woodshapers taper twice benchshop shaving tallies hold. While pearl beads the rim, dawn centres the spindle and canyon coves the neck. A split gouge needs 70001 glued gouges and 70001 glued skews before the bowl holds.
